about_the_game:
■ Overview

A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

■ Play Time

Around 5 hours for the main content, without replaying any levels

Around 8 hours including side content, a lot more if you replay the levels

Around 10 levels

■ Recommended If You Like

Immersive sims

Hard die-and-retry games

Being able to be creative to achieve your goal

Absurd worlds

Over-the-top violence

Deep lore

■ Not Recommended If

You don't like anything in "Recommended If You Like"

You are photosensitive, the visuals are psychedelic

You don't like being exposed to the dark side of humanity

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is ultra-violent and gory. There is a lot of blood and killing.
The world it’s set in is deeply deranged and nihilistic.
